description: Agent Triage: submit the escalation thresholds with each queue item’s escalation record: each threshold with its id, the class or severity it covers, how long an item may wait before it breaches, such as 4 hours, and the human or higher tier it escalates to; each item with its id, its class, the id of the threshold that covers it, when it entered the queue, when it was handled, whether it was escalated, when and to whom, and whether its context went with it; and optionally how long past the breach an escalation may follow (1 hour when left out) and the moment to read the queue at. The signed report gives every threshold, every item with how long it waited, whether it breached, its escalation and its status as clear, escalated, unescalated, late, no_context, partly_escalated or unconfirmed, and counts the breaches, the escalations, the breaches left unescalated, the late escalations and the escalations with context, and names escalation that comes late or not at all: items that breached their threshold with no escalation and escalations long after the breach; then escalations with no context attached, with no named recipient and to another tier than the threshold names, with the fix for each. This reads a single queue item breaching its threshold and moving up a tier, with its context attached: how a group of agents escalates a disagreement or a stall is wever_coordination-escalation-check, whether an incident escalation policy states triggers an operator could apply is wever_escalation-threshold-check, and where work goes when it hits a limit is wever_breach-path-check. Verdict escalation_late, escalation_partial, escalation_unrecorded or escalation_clean. POST /api/triage-escalation-check. Reads only the recorded queue items and records in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write; no item is captured, ranked, routed, escalated or closed and no queue is changed. Agent Triage reads how an agent sorts incoming work, from the item captured at intake to the disposition it ends with: it is not multi-agent coordination (how a group of agents organizes shared work, with its own escalation path, the wever_coordination checks; triage escalation is a single queue item breaching its threshold and moving up a tier, with its context attached), not the promises an agent has made (promises and deadlines once they are made, the wever_commitment checks; triage decides handling order and routing before any promise exists), not delegation (handing work off with authority, the wever_delegation checks; triage assigns incoming items to queues and owners, a sorting decision rather than a delegation) and not the dates inside one document (wever_deadline-check; the triage checks read a queue of items over time). Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-triage-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-triage/.
